name: Gala360
summary:
Gala360 was a community for 360-degree photography. Between 2016 and 2022 its members shared panoramas of cities, coastlines, mountains, temples, festivals and the places they called home. This app brings that library back, rebuilt from the ground up for Meta Quest.

- Browse albums of full-sphere panoramas and stand inside each scene.
- Follow hotspot tours: aim at a marker and step to the next viewpoint.
- Stereo 3D panoramas are shown in depth, one image per eye.
- Comfortable by design: seated or standi
